description: Read one document by id or any written form (bill:2025-2026/hb136, SB 3, opinion:S26A0060, 317 Ga. 528, code:16-11-127, O.C.G.A. § 16-11-127, ga-const:art-i-sec-i-para-iii, meeting:2026-02-05/house-rules, a page URL) as Markdown, at most `max_chars` (default 60,000) from `start`, with a pointer to the rest. `metadata` lists its versions, links grouped by relation, and parts (`part` reads one: a bill's votes or history, a meeting's transcript). A version id (`...@key`) reads that version. A hierarchy node (code:t16, code:t16/c11, ga-const:art-i) returns its children. A bill number used in more than one session returns the choices. `around` takes a passage citation from search and returns the text around it.

around.description: A passage citation from search (version_id#start-end): the text around it.
around.title: Around

id.description: A document id or any written form of one (a bill number, docket, citation, page URL), a version id, or a hierarchy node.
id.title: Id

include.description: Parts to add to metadata (e.g. votes, history).
include.title: Include

part.description: document (default), or one of the parts metadata.parts lists.
part.title: Part

start.description: Character offset to read from (the pointer at the end of a window gives it).
start.title: Start

name: fetch
title: Read one document
